description: This file defines a PHP class PerformanceTrackerSearchFilterParams, which extends a FilterParams class and is used to specify filtering parameters for searching performance tracker records in the OrangeHRM performance module. It includes configuration for sorting fields and a property for employee number filtering.

classes.name: PerformanceTrackerSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object for filtering search results related to performance trackers, including sortable fields and employee number filtering.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of the class, setting default sort field to 'performanceTracker.modifiedDate' and sort order to descending.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number filter criterion.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number filter criterion.
